claim: The optimal EEG depression model is regime-dependent: shallow Riemannian K-NN (NrDE K=3; mean AUC 0.788) is best at clinical-scale N~53 where deep encoders overfit; adversarial SPD alignment (SpectSPD-DANN; LODO mean AUC 0.723; pooled AUC 0.788) is best when multi-site transfer is required — demonstrated under the first rigorous leave-one-dataset-out protocol across three independent EEG depression corpora

No prior EEG depression work applies Riemannian SPD manifold geometry to the cross-dataset transfer problem; existing cross-dataset methods (e.g. WDANet) use Wasserstein or Euclidean domain alignment and evaluate pairwise source-to-target transfer — not a 3-way LODO protocol that exposes all three distribution shift directions simultaneously

EEG covariance matrices form a Riemannian manifold of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices; Riemannian geometry operations (Frechet mean; tangent space projection) are geometrically necessary and outperform Euclidean approximations in cross-subject EEG classification

At clinical-scale N~53 (MODMA; Mumtaz; OpenNeuro individually) transductive Riemannian K-NN (NrDE K=3) achieves mean AUC 0.788 across three datasets and is competitive with the best published within-dataset result on MODMA (EEG-RCformer AUC 0.7154); deep encoders trained at this scale overfit between-subject identity

Cross-dataset EEG shift is a rotation of the SPD correlation axis across sites — not a simple mean shift; only learned adversarial SPD alignment (SpectSPD-DANN with GRL) bridges this gap; the MODMA LODO fold rises from AUC 0.58 (shallow transfer) to 0.764 (adversarial alignment)

SpectSPD-DANN achieves mean LODO AUC 0.723 (MODMA 0.764; Mumtaz 0.811; OpenNeuro 0.594) under strict 3-way leave-one-dataset-out with 4-seed ensemble; the MODMA fold is competitive with WDANet (AUC 0.74-0.76) on a strictly harder three-site protocol

When all three datasets are pooled (N=232) SpectSPD-DANN surpasses NrDE (AUC 0.788 vs 0.745; Bal-Acc 0.710 vs 0.684) and clears all three >=70% bars with honest threshold calibration — confirming the data-volume crossover: the regime that favours the deep model begins at approximately N=232
